# ADR-3213: AWS encryption: Prefer automatic KMS key rotation for CMK 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Manual rotation is often skipped.

## Decision

Security teams SHOULD prefer automatic KMS key rotation for CMK 5 (AWS-encryption-5) when keys guard long-lived data.

## Consequences

Apps is expected to tolerate key version changes.
